notes: DBpedia exposes bulk datasets through Databus collections/groups and documents query patterns that resolve latest-version download URLs. Current scope was English-only (all resources filter dataid-cv:lang=en). Stopped 2026-08-29: acquisition was deliberately discontinued due to poor upstream data quality and replaced with wikidata as the equivalent global/cross-jurisdiction source (see docs/architecture.md section 7, 'DBpedia -- a stopped case study'). This status was previously left as research_required after the decision to stop was made, which read as still-pending rather than closed; corrected to stopped so the catalog matches the documented decision.

research.basis: DBpedia dev Download_DBpedia documentation plus DBpedia forum guidance on large extraction workloads
research.approach: Use Databus bulk-first acquisition: resolve latest file URLs from documented Databus query patterns (group/artifact + language/contentVariant filters), then process downloaded RDF dump files offline. Restrict discovery and extraction to English distributions for the current phase.
research.next_action: None while stopped. Reclassify status away from stopped first (e.g. back to research_required) if DBpedia is ever revisited, then resume from: expand English Databus resource coverage for organization extraction, then define RDF parsing/flattening rules that produce deterministic company-name rows for sharding validation.
